inputs.name: hour
inputs.type: float (hour of day at interval start)
inputs.allowed: 0 to 23.75 in steps of 0.25 (the exported table uses integer hours 0-23)
inputs.twin_signal: Simulation clock of the twin (hour + minute/60)

inputs.name: day
inputs.twin_signal: Simulation clock of the twin (day of week)
inputs.model_use: one-hot, 7 columns (WeekStatus is derivable from it and is not used)

inputs.name: load_type
inputs.twin_signal: SAG mill tonnage divided by nominal tonnage

excluded.name: Lagging_Current_Reactive.Power_kVarh
excluded.reason: Analysed in the lab only; the twin cannot produce it.

excluded.name: Leading_Current_Reactive_Power_kVarh
excluded.reason: Analysed in the lab only; the twin cannot produce it.

excluded.name: Lagging_Current_Power_Factor
excluded.reason: Analysed in the lab only; the twin cannot produce it.

excluded.name: Leading_Current_Power_Factor
excluded.reason: Analysed in the lab only; the twin cannot produce it.

excluded.name: NSM
excluded.reason: Seconds since midnight; redundant with the hour of day.

excluded.name: CO2(tCO2)
excluded.reason: Almost a copy of consumption (VIF); computed afterwards from kWh.

preprocessing.interval_convention: The file stamps the END of each 15-min interval. Features use the interval START (end - 15 min); the 00:00 record closes the previous day.
preprocessing.trees: ColumnTransformer (one-hot + sin/cos passthrough) -> RandomForest / XGBoost, no scaling

co2_tco2.note: CO2 is derived from kWh after the prediction; it never enters the model.

variable_contract.load_type_rule_summary: load_type from SAG tonnage / nominal: < 0.75 Light, <= 0.90 Medium, > 0.90 Maximum

notes: El modelo exportado es XGBoost: el de menor MAE en el examen (1 oct a 31 dic 2018), entrenado solo con 1 ene a 30 sep.
La tabla de predicción promedia las predicciones de los minutos :00, :15, :30 y :45 de cada hora; el valor es kWh por intervalo de 15 min.
Las frases de scenario_explanations provienen de los valores SHAP de XGBoost (aporte de hora, día y carga sobre el promedio de la planta).
Combinaciones que casi no ocurren en los datos (por ejemplo carga máxima en domingo de madrugada) son extrapolaciones del modelo.
El CO2 no entra al modelo: se calcula como kWh por el factor de variable_contract.post_computed.
Corte por inicio de intervalo: entrenamiento hasta 2018-09-30 23:45, examen desde 2018-10-01 00:00.
MAPE se calcula solo sobre registros con consumo real mayor o igual a 1 kWh.
